VIDEO SCRIPT: DIVISION
Grade: Grade 4 · Subject: MATHEMATICS

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Division. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Division undoes multiplication.
• Always check by multiplying.

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• 24 ÷ 6 = 4
• 36 ÷ 4 = 9
• 30 ÷ 5 = 6

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Work out 18 ÷ 3, 28 ÷ 7, 40 ÷ 8. Multiply to check.

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Division.”
